subject: Cross-region residency architecture: deep-dive scheduling and owners
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@everglobal.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@everglobal.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cross-region residency technical deep-dive

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Our infra and legal teams want a separate technical deep-dive focused specifically on multi-region residency and the routing/data flow implications for EU / US / APAC. High level asks:

- Confirm where customer data is stored vs. where inference runs (transient KV vs persistent logs)
- Network egress patterns and certificate/key handling for VPC/private deployments
- How Redwood's fallbacks work when a region is constrained (model variants, cache routing)
- Compliance/artifact list we can share with our SOC & procurement teams

Can we book a 90-minute session that includes one infra engineer from Redwood, an SRE who understands KV cache behavior, and someone from your compliance team? Our suggested windows next week (all in CET):
- Tue 2027-05-18 09:00-10:30 CET
- Wed 2027-05-19 14:00-15:30 CET

If those don't work for Redwood, we can split into two 45-minute sessions to accommodate APAC. Attendees from our side: myself (Samir), Priya Desai (infra lead), Alex Chen (legal).

I've attached a short list of initial requirements (see EG-Res-Reqs.xlsx referenced) — happy to expand if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Platform Engineering, EverGlobal

[attachment: EG-Res-Reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@everglobal.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@everglobal.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cross-region residency technical deep-dive

Samir —

Appreciate the clarity. We can run a 90-minute consolidated deep-dive but I want to be mindful of APAC attendees; if needed we can record and run a short follow-up for APAC. Proposed plan:

- 15m: introductions & scope (Hannah)
- 35m: architecture walkthrough (Vivek) — routing, KV cache, quantization concerns
- 20m: security & compliance artifacts (Karthik) — audit logs, retention controls, KMS/HSM integration notes
- 20m: Q&A / next steps / roll-out playbook (all)

Two tentative slot options (converted to CET/UTC):
- Option A: Tue 2027-05-18 09:00-10:30 CET (16:00-17:30 SGT)
- Option B: Thu 2027-05-20 07:00-08:30 CET (14:00-15:30 SGT)

I attached our draft playbook (EG-Redwood-Residency-Playbook-v1.pdf) with initial mappings so your team can flag gaps. Could you confirm which slot works and whether we should add any Redwood legal folks? Also confirm whether you'll need an NDA first (we can expedite).

Thanks — will loop in internal owners after you confirm.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Solutions (Americas), Redwood Inference

[attachment: EG-Redwood-Residency-Playbook-v1.pdf (pdf stub)]

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@everglobal.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@everglobal.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: cross-region residency technical deep-dive

Hannah —

Thanks for the proposed agenda. A couple of notes from our side:

- Alex from legal can't do the mornings CET next week; can we avoid 09:00 CET on Tue if possible.
- We have an APAC engineering stakeholder (Manisha, SGT) who would prefer a slot after 14:00 SGT. If meeting is at 16:00 SGT on Tue that's OK, otherwise might need split.
- We do need a short list of compliance artifacts in advance for our SOC review (SOC 2 scoping, retention/export proofpoints).

Can you hold Option A tentatively while we check internal calendars? I attached a calendar invite stub for the two options (cross-region-deepdive.ics).

Best,
Priya Desai
Infra Lead, EverGlobal

[attachment: cross-region-deepdive.ics (calendar stub)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: owners and prep for EverGlobal residency deep-dive

Vivek / Karthik —

Quick internal note before I confirm with EverGlobal:

- Vivek: you're the primary for the routing + KV cache section (35m). Please prepare a slide on cache prefix behavior, cold-starts, and routing policies (5–7 slides).
- Karthik: lead the compliance artifacts segment. Pull SOC 2 mapping, audit log retention samples, and our KMS/HSM integration diagram.
- Marissa: can you join as a solutions engineer to run the demo snippet showing regional failover? We'll need a short runbook for the demo so it goes smoothly.

I'll tentatively hold Tue 18th 09:00 CET (Option A) with the customer for now but will confirm by EOD after Priya checks. If APAC cannot make it, we will record and schedule a 30-minute APAC-focused follow-up.

Thanks — can each of you reply with availability and whether you need content help from Docs or Legal?

Hannah

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: owners and prep for EverGlobal residency deep-dive

All —

Confirmed. I'll assemble the compliance/attestation packet and a one-page artifact checklist (SOC 2 sections, retention windows, export controls). Vivek — can you share a short config snippet for the KV caching behavior (how prefix caching vs full model cache is handled)? I will stitch into the deck.

I've attached a quick deck draft (residency-deck-v2.pptx) with the agenda and slide placeholders — feel free to populate.

Available for a prep run on Mon 2027-05-17 09:00 PT if that works for everyone.

Thanks,
Karthik
